full_page.content:
1934, April
FR. OLANUS, NOTEBOOK NO. S.
Page 190 Apr. 25th Charles Chabot - 50 - operation rupture arranged for to-morrow. Mrs. Martin - 42 - non Cath. Asthma - Bahiism ..... new prophet India.
Mary O'Warren - 65 - Centerline - dying of cancer
Cecylia Gutowski - 23 - terrible fits of cursing - barky like dog, etc, etc, believed to be possessed ????
Dr. Adler - about 35 - professor in Chicago - Jew +1 - philosophy according to St. Thomas. After an hour's listening-in Dr. Deaty of Marygrove asked the Prof. about his views "so Catholic" was as- sured the Prof had been convinced in his "research-work that it is the only real philosophy."
Anna Justine Frown - 45 - depressed 2 growing-up children, widow 11 years.
Mrs. Boik - 56 - 7 children-struggling on farm with cattle, geese, duck, etc ... bad neighbor. ...
Mrs. Amy - 30 - from Alpena - fearful headaches - apointment made to enter Ford Hospital at noon To-day ....
Page 191 April Cha's Walker & M. F. marrying - her mother anxious about his not practicing his religion - no Mass, no Sacraments .....!
May O' Rourk - to married June 12 th .... T.B. of intestines
Mrs. Van Neck - 62 - liver enlarged - yellow jandis .... gall-stones. Drs. feard to operate sent her home to get strong first. Now so improving since enrolled & prayed for .. hopes not to be necessary to go back.
Mr. & Mrs. Peltier - Quarreling, drinking, bad example to children 2 ..... She denies -- he'll .....
May devotions
Frank Sarbmowsk - 45 - terrible pains in
Jos. Cedrie Cote - 16 - youth infantile paralysis (now 4 yrs .), mother not Catholic in Wis .... Aunt a daily Communicant. . . Very remarkable .....
